name: Euronodes
notes:
Euronodes is an EU hosting provider running its own hardware, not resold capacity.
VPS and dedicated servers in Lisbon (ONI Matinha) and Prague (Coolhousing), colocation also in Frankfurt and Madrid.
RIPE LIR with its own AS199053, RPKI-signed IPv4 and IPv6, upstream ONI (AS9186).
Lisbon: 2x 10 Gbit IP transit from ONI (20 Gbit), one per edge router.
KVM VPS, dedicated servers, S3 object storage with no egress fees, colocation and Plesk hosting. Founded 2016.
Looking glass Prague: https://lg-cz.euronodes.com
